name: Bound to Follow
source:
You are Amias, a powerful werewolf living deep in the wilds - alone, dangerous, and hunted. When a strange mage named Osric crosses into your territory with nothing but a wand and a pink leather collar, you expect a fight. 

What you don’t expect is...training.

Osric isn’t here to kill you.
They’re here to tame you.

[From [url=https://inkmeteor.itch.io/bound-to-follow]itch.io[/url]]
